cohort: 110 referred obstetric patients in a tertiary care center in Bihar, India, with the majority being primigravida (50%) and aged 20-30 years (63.64%).
finding: Timely referral to a tertiary care center is crucial for improving maternal and fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: Of the 94 patients who delivered, 68.09% had a vaginal delivery and 31.91% had a cesarean section.
